title: API Testing
description: Roles and Responsibilities Lead end-to-end quality engineering for REST APIs, from requirements analysis to production validation for 5-9 years' scale projects. Design, implement, and maintain robust API test strategies covering functional, integration, contract, regression, and negative testing. Drive API test automation frameworks and suites, ensuring high coverage, reliability, and maintainability across services and microservices. Collaborate with architects and developers to review API specifications (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI), ensuring testability, consistency, and adherence to standards. Define and enforce best practices for API testing, automation, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines. Analyze complex defects and production issues, perform root cause analysis, and work with cross-functional teams to implement long-term fixes. Mentor and guide junior QA/automation engineers on API testing techniques, tools, and automation patterns. Additional Responsibilities Good to Have Skills: API design review, Contract testing, Performance testing, CI/CD integration, Agile methodologies Technical Requirements Extensive experience in API test automation, including building and maintaining automation suites for REST APIs. Demonstrated ability to define test strategies, test plans, and quality processes for complex, distributed systems. Experience integrating automated API tests into CI/CD pipelines and working in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong background in overall Testing practices, including test design techniques, risk-based testing, and regression optimization. Proven track record of leading small to medium QA/automation teams, providing technical guidance and code reviews for test assets. Ability to analyze logs, traces, and API responses to quickly diagnose issues and support root cause analysis. You'll collaborate closely with architects, developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to build robust test strategies that keep pace with modern, cloud-native delivery. This is an opportunity to influence technical direction, mentor engineers, and introduce smarter ways of working-using automation, metrics, and continuous improvement. If you enjoy solving intricate integration challenges, designing scalable API test frameworks, and leading teams toward engineering excellence, this role gives you the platform to make a visible impact while growing as a technology leader. title: Staff Software Engineer- Test
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. About the role We're hiring an SDET-2 (Software Development Engineer in Test) in Bengaluru to own quality for the services our customers depend on. You'll decide what to test and how, build and maintain automation, test by hand where it finds problems fastest, and help the team ship often without breaking customers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Quality is a first-class priority for us, not a phase at the end. You'll work closely with developers, Product, Customer Support and your Engineering Manager. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own quality for a service or product area end to end — test strategy, automation, release sign-off, and follow-up on escaped bugs. Test strategy. Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. When a bug reaches customers, find out why and close the gap so it doesn't happen again. Raise the bar. Review test code, mentor SDET-1s, and help interview candidates. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 2–5 years in software testing or development. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've built automation that runs in CI. Test suites you designed or substantially extended, that run on every change and that the team trusts. You own quality, not just test cases. You've decided what to test for a feature or release, and stood behind the call. You are comfortable testing by hand. You use manual and exploratory testing deliberately, where it finds problems faster than scripts. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a feature or release, you plan the testing, unblock yourself, and raise risks early. Test plan Breakdown: You can take product requirements and create deep test plan including all corner cases to ensure Quality We care how you test more than which tool you did it in. Technical background You've tested production systems with a modern stack, such as: Languages: strong in at least one language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript — you write test code with the same care as product code. Test automation: frameworks such as Pytest, JUnit/TestNG, Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including structuring a suite so it stays maintainable. APIs and services: contract and integration testing of REST APIs, including error paths, auth and data validation. CI and cloud: running tests in CI pipelines, and testing services deployed on AWS — reading logs and metrics to diagnose failures. Databases: SQL to set up and verify data, and an understanding of how data issues show up as bugs. Non-functional testing: exposure to performance or load testing with tools such as JMeter, k6 or Locust. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Escaped bugs went down, release time went down, or flaky tests went away — and you can say what you did to get there. A suite you made better. You took slow or flaky automation and made it fast and trusted, not just bigger. Framework mindset: You spot repeated test code and turn it into reusable helpers, fixtures or tooling others build on. Root-cause thinking. You trace a failure to its cause in code, data or config, not just report the symptom. Product sense. You've pushed back on a release, or on a requirement that would confuse users, and been right. Lifting others. Test reviews, docs or mentoring that made developers and newer SDETs better at quality. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You test the way customers actually work, and you treat every escaped bug and support ticket as a lesson. Impact over activity. You measure success by bugs that never reached customers and releases that went out smoothly, not test-case counts. Honesty. You report quality as it is, say clearly what wasn't tested, and raise release risks even when it's unwelcome. Independence. You don't wait to be told what to test. You find the risk worth covering and get it done with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a tool you built, a technique you went deep on, things you taught others. Depth. At least one system you've tested well enough to explain its internals, its failure modes and how you'd test them. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

description: Über uns Wir sind finbyte, ein Technologieunternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin. Wir helfen Unternehmen, Fintech-Lösungen zu entwickeln und innovative Angebote auf den Markt zu bringen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und pflegst moderne Webanwendungen mit React, Angular oder Vue.js. Du arbeitest mit den Teams für Backend-Entwicklung, Design und Produkt zusammen. Du wirkst an Architekturentscheidungen mit und beteiligst dich an Code-Reviews und technischen Diskussionen. Das bringst du mit Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Frontend-Entwicklung. Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einem modernen JavaScript-Framework wie React, Angular oder Vue.js. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript (ES6+) und TypeScript. Fundierte Kenntnisse in HTML5, CSS3, responsivem Design und modernen Methoden der Webentwicklung. Erfahrung mit der Integration von REST-APIs und der Arbeit mit Backend-Services. Vertrautheit mit Git, Code-Reviews und CI/CD-Workflows. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung skalierbarer, wartbarer und produktionsreifer Webanwendungen. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz und die Fähigkeit, in funktionsübergreifenden Teams eigenständig zu arbeiten. Sehr gute Deutsch und Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau in Wort und Schrift und die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen verständlich zu erklären. Von Vorteil Praktische Erfahrung mit React.js, idealerweise in umfangreichen Anwendungen im Produktivbetrieb. Erfahrung mit Next.js und serverseitigem Rendering (SSR). Erfahrung mit Frontend-Testframeworks wie Jest, Vitest oder Playwright. Vertrautheit mit Micro-Frontend-Architekturen. Berufserfahrung im Bankwesen, im Fintech-Bereich oder bei Finanzdienstleistern. Erfahrung mit Barrierefreiheit nach WCAG und mit der Optimierung der Web-Performance. So bewirbst du dich Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf über LinkedIn oder per E-Mail. Wir freuen uns, wenn du uns von einer Webanwendung oder einer Frontend-Funktion erzählst, die du mitentwickelt oder verbessert hast, und deinen Beitrag dazu beschreibst.

title: Junior Developer – Tech Team
description: About the Role Ever looked at a task and thought, "There must be an easier way to do this!"? Well, that's exactly what our Tech Team does at Team Everest! We build applications, automate repetitive tasks, and use technology to make things easier for people. It could be an application for our teammates, a tool for our volunteers, or a digital solution for any of our stakeholders. As our Junior Developer, you will help build applications, develop websites, connect different systems, and solve problems using technology based on our organization's needs. You will also learn how to use AI to write code, build applications, and work smarter. And you won't be doing it alone! You will work with different teams, understand their needs, and help create solutions that make things easier for the people who use them. If you love coding, solving problems, experimenting with new technology, and learning new things, this role is for you! What You Will Do? Application & Website Development Build and customize applications based on our organization's needs. Understand requirements from our teams and stakeholders and turn them into working applications and features. Develop new features and improve existing applications to make them faster and easier to use. Work with databases to store, organize, and manage application data. Help develop and maintain websites and landing pages using web development technologies. Automation & Integrations Write scripts and create workflows to automate repetitive tasks. Connect different applications and systems to help them work together. Work with APIs to exchange data between applications and understand how requests, responses, and authentication work. Testing & AI Development Test applications manually and using basic automated testing methods. Find errors, fix bugs, and make sure everything works properly. Use AI tools to write code, develop applications, automate tasks, and improve productivity. Learn how to understand, test, and verify AI-generated code before using it. Teamwork & Collaboration Work with different teams and stakeholders to understand their problems and help develop technical solutions. Participate in team discussions, project planning, and code reviews. Keep your teammates updated on your work and complete assigned tasks on time. Requirements What We’re Looking For? Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. B.E., B.Tech., B.Sc., BCA, or equivalent qualifications in relevant fields can apply. Experience: Freshers can apply! Skills required for Job: Programming & Technical Skills Programming Knowledge: You should know the basics of at least one programming language. You should understand concepts like variables, loops, conditions, functions, and data structures. Web Development: You should have a basic understanding of how websites and web pages are built. Database Knowledge: You should understand basic database concepts like tables, relationships, and adding, viewing, updating, or deleting data. API Knowledge: You should have a basic understanding of how different applications communicate and exchange data. Testing & Debugging: You should be willing to test your code, identify errors, and fix them. Problem-Solving & AI Skills Problem-Solving Skills: You should enjoy understanding problems, thinking logically, and finding solutions. Critical & Analytical Thinking: You should be able to look at a problem from different angles and find a practical way to solve it. Creative Thinking: You should enjoy experimenting with new ideas and finding better ways to do things. AI Skills: You should be interested in using AI for coding and development. You should also be open to learning new AI tools and attending AI training. Communication & Work Skills Communication Skills: You should be able to understand requirements, explain your ideas, and give clear updates about your work. Teamwork: You should enjoy working with people from different teams to develop solutions. Computer Skills: You should be comfortable using computers and basic office software. Work Ethic: You should be someone who loves to learn, works hard, pays attention to detail, and can complete tasks independently & with a team. Added Advantage Knowledge or experience with any of the following tools and technologies will be an added advantage. You don't need to know all of them! Application Development: Zoho Creator, Zoho CRM, Zoho Analytics, Zoho Forms, Zoho Flow, or other low-code platforms. Scripting & Automation: Deluge or similar scripting languages. Web Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, or TypeScript. Programming: Python, Java, or similar languages. Databases & Integrations: SQL, REST APIs, or JSON. Development Tools: Git or similar version control tools. What Makes You a Perfect Fit? A person who is Honest. A person who gives importance to Values. Someone who looks forward to coming to the office because they love what they do. In short, a person with passion and love for the work they do. A person who is ready to work in a non-profit organization to create a positive impact in the community. A person who is ready to work in a Team Environment. A gentle and friendly person who our teammates will love to work with. A person who is open to Learn and Unlearn. In short, you should be coachable. Someone who is ready to try new things and not afraid of failures. Someone who is ready to acknowledge mistakes when they know they are wrong. Someone who is committed and ready to take accountability. Someone who delivers on time when a responsibility is given to them. Other Information Scope: Full-time Experience: Freshers can apply Probationary Period: 3 months Commitment: We expect you to work with us for at least 2 years. No formal agreements, we work on trust! Designation: As per experience Working Days: Monday to Friday + 2 working Saturdays a month. Some weekend support may be required based on program needs. Office Timings: 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM Office Address: Work from Chennai Joining Date: Immediate Benefits Why You Should Join Us? An Ocean of Learning: Learning never stops at Team Everest. It’s good for you and your career. Fun & Supportive Team: Fun is integral to our work culture. You will never feel alone at Team Everest. You will always find a helping hand for any of your work-related queries. Diverse Team: Work with teammates from across India. Learn new languages and make friends from different states. Challenging Opportunities: We believe taking challenging opportunities helps a person grow faster. We are ready to challenge you if you are ready for it! Generalists, not just specialists: You will learn multiple skills in addition to your specialization, helping you to strengthen your career and reduce future career risk. Use Technology for Good: Learn & Use advanced tech tools and stay on top. Use AI: AI will not replace you. But a person who uses AI might replace you. You will learn various AI tools while working with us. Be up to date. Annual Team Outings: We go on a yearly team outing to build strong bonds. Ready to Apply? If you have always wanted to help others with your time and skills, Team Everest is your place!
